note: Plate shows Herald (E-W, centre y~4492) and Station Street (N-S, x 7898-7962) ending at Herald from the north; city-limits line runs along Station St. Assumed Musketeer Dr = old Herald and Cleneay Ave = old Station St, which matches the expected point closely.
Rutland is only a short stub (y 6130-6200) on the east side of Montgomery, cut by the plate edge right away; the point is on the Montgomery centreline opposite the stub.

S. Crescent (Avenue; now S. Fred Shuttlesworth Circle) leaves Reading Road eastward. West of Reading, a little further north, there is a stub labelled '...T AVE.' at about (1060,4140); it is a different street. The plate edge runs along Reading's west side but the crossing is on the plate.
Same crossing as 75_018: S. Crescent leaves Reading Road eastward.

The two given names (Francis Xavier Way and Saint Francis Xavier Way) are modern Xavier campus roads. At the expected point the plate shows Mougey Avenue ending at the N-S street at x 6630-6720 (numbered 3713-3758; printed 'WOODBURN' south of Dana). I picked the Woodburn/Mougey T as the likely predecessor; it is 'found' only on that assumption.

An E-W 50-ft 'AVE.' (centre y~6578) ends at x~3100 at a city-owned strip ('CITY') that lies along Victory Blvd; its sewers continue to Victory. The point is the street's centreline carried to Victory's centreline (taken from the 'VICTORY' label axis). The plate is cut along Victory's SE side. The expected point (3571,6362) falls outside the plate area. Glenwood Ave also ends near Victory at about (3370,6290).

At the expected point (7368,4504) Herald runs E-W (centre y~4492), but no street meets it there, only lot lines and an 18-inch sewer at x~7480. The nearest side street is Tibbles Street, which ends at Herald from the north at (7200,4492), about 170 px west. Saint Francis Xavier Way looks like a later campus road.

printed: Road (Reading Road; 'ROAD' printed to the SW)
note: Fork: Reading Road comes from the SW and continues NE (60 ft, 12-inch water pipe). A short stub carrying the streetcar track leaves NNW, cut by the plate edge; taken as Paddock Road. Eugenia also joins at nearly the same point from the east (see 75_027).
Eugenia (E-W, y 797-890) and a 40-ft N-S 'AVE.' (x 4422-4482) that ends at Eugenia from the south. Assumed Barry Lane = Eugenia and Glen Lyon Ave = the N-S avenue.

A 60-ft 'AVE.' stub (Greenwood) joins Reading from the west, cut by the plate edge. Burton Avenue leaves Reading on the east side almost opposite, centred about 50 px further NE, so this is nearly a cross.

printed: Reading Road (curving NE segment, not labelled here)
note: At the expected point, Reading Road curves NE along the plate edge. On its SE side lies the Mitchell estate (lots 42, 57) with only a lot line at x~4480, so no side street exists in 1922 and Debbe Lane is not on the plate.

Eugenia (now taken as Barry Lane, see 75_024) runs west past the tip of the Mitchell triangle and opens into the Reading/Paddock junction. Its centreline meets Reading's centreline almost at the Paddock fork (75_023, 3828,724). The plate edge is right at the junction.

The N-S 60-ft 'AVENUE' (x 6555-6652) reaches the top of the plate, where an E-W street (south edge y~40) is labelled 'HOPKINS' in letters cut by the page edge. The street centre is essentially at or beyond the edge. Assumed Asmann Ave = Hopkins and Ledgewood = the AVENUE.

printed: Avenue (N-S street, name not printed here)
note: Victory Parkway is not built here. A city-owned strip (green band, 'CITY' lettering, 'VICTORY' label) crosses the Lyons and 'FOR..EST' estates on the line the parkway later took. Two parallel dashed lines (one labelled 120-inch sewer) cross the N-S street (x 6592-6685) at y~2334 and y~2676; the point is between them. The green band's NW edge crosses at y~2183. Could be treated as not found.

The 'SPRINGS' stub carries a streetcar track curving onto Reading from the west and is cut by the plate edge. Another stub, '...L AVE.', joins just north at about (2580,2180). Marion Ave leaves to the east further south at about (2500,2500).
A 60-ft diagonal 'WAY' (now Winding Way) ends at the N-S 'AVENUE' (x ~6572-6668, now Ledgewood) from the WSW.
